explanation: Tintin first appeared in 1929 in Le Petit Vingtième, a Belgian newspaper's children's supplement. Asterix arrived 30 years later, in 1959, in the first issue of the French magazine Pilote.

claims.text: Tintin first appeared in 1929, in Le Petit Vingtième.
Asterix first appeared in 1959, in the first issue of the French magazine Pilote.
Le Petit Vingtième was the children's supplement of the Belgian newspaper Le Vingtième Siècle.
